name: EHP Resort & Marina

address.street: 295 Three Mile Harbor Hog Creek Rd

insider_take: Where Hamptons glamour meets waterfront luxury in an intimate resort setting that feels more like a sophisticated private club than a hotel.
whats_special: This boutique waterfront gem sits on Shinnecock Bay with its own full-service marina, making it the only resort in the Hamptons where you can literally sail up to your accommodation. The property features just 42 rooms, ensuring an exclusive experience amid 22 pristine acres of bayfront paradise.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room during summer to catch the spectacular sunsets over Shinnecock Bay, and consider arriving by boat—the resort's marina can accommodate yachts up to 120 feet.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach club access and the award-winning Coast Grill restaurant, which sources ingredients from local Hamptons farms and serves some of the region's freshest seafood with panoramic water views.
pros: Prime Hamptons location with exclusive marina access
Full-service resort amenities including spa and fine dining
Luxury waterfront accommodations with stunning bay views
World-class marina facilities for yacht and boat enthusiasts
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive Hamptons location
Seasonal availability may be limited during peak summer months
